message: `?` propagates `F`, which does not convert to `E`, the error type of `closure`

notes.message: an error converts when it is the same type, when the target is `Error` and it implements `Display`, or when the target enum has a `from F` variant (core 2.6)
or convert it where it fails: `.map_err(fn(e: F) -> E { ... })?` (core 2.6)
add a variant such as `F(from F)` to `E`
